name: Joinery Wishlist
author: joinery

sections.description:
Joinery Wishlist adds an “Add to wishlist” link to your product pages and product lists. Customers find everything they saved on the Wishlist page, with prices, stock and an add to cart button for each product.

  • Works for guests too. A guest’s wishlist is kept for their visit and moves into their account when they sign in.
  • Signed-in customers also find their wishlist under My Account → Wishlist.
  • Customers can share their wishlist with a private link. Anyone with the link can see it, but not change it. Shared lists are hidden from search engines.
  • Works with classic and block themes, and needs no setup: activating the plugin creates the Wishlist page. Move the [joinery_wishlist] shortcode to any page you like.
  • Uses your theme’s own WooCommerce styles, and no JavaScript.

Privacy

Joinery Wishlist doesn’t contact any external service and doesn’t track you or your customers. Wishlists are stored in your own database and work with WordPress’s personal data export and erasure tools. The plugin suggests text for your privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Joinery Wishlist.
  3. Visit any product: “Add to wishlist” appears under the add to cart button.
sections.faq:
Where is the wishlist page?

Activating the plugin creates a page called Wishlist with the [joinery_wishlist] shortcode. Add it to your menu, or put the shortcode on another page.

What happens to wishlists if I delete the plugin?

They’re deleted with it, along with share links. The Wishlist page stays, so you can delete it yourself.

0.1.0

  • First version: wishlists for guests and customers, the Wishlist page and My Account tab, share links, and personal data export and erasure.
